title: RNA Tertiary Structure Prediction and Analysis Using NuFold and the NuFold Database.
authors: Liu, Boyuan; Kagaya, Yuki; Platt, David; Kihara, Daisuke
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍RNA三级结构预测工具NuFold及其数据库，虽对象为RNA而非蛋白质，但其基于深度学习的端到端结构预测框架可迁移至蛋白质结构计算，对本课题有借鉴价值。
abstract: Accurate prediction of RNA tertiary structure is critical for understanding the functions of diverse non-coding RNAs, yet experimental structure determination remains challenging and resource intensive. Inspired by advances in deep learning for protein structure prediction, NuFold was developed as an end-to-end framework that predicts all-atom RNA tertiary structures directly from sequence. NuFold integrates evolutionary information from multiple sequence alignments and predicted secondary structure features to construct 3D coordinates of RNA. To maximize accessibility, NuFold is available as open-source software, supported by a Google Colab notebook for browser-based prediction and NuFold DB, a large-scale repository of precomputed RNA structures. This chapter provides a practical guide to using these resources, enabling researchers to generate and interpret RNA structural models without extensive computational resources, and thereby facilitating structural and functional studies in RNA biology.
abstract_zh: RNA三级结构的准确预测对于理解多种非编码RNA的功能至关重要，然而实验结构测定仍然具有挑战性且资源密集。受蛋白质结构预测深度学习进展的启发，NuFold被开发为一个端到端框架，直接从序列预测RNA的全原子三级结构。NuFold整合了来自多序列比对和预测二级结构特征的进化信息，以构建RNA的三维坐标。为了最大化可访问性，NuFold作为开源软件提供，并支持通过Google Colab笔记本进行基于浏览器的预测，以及NuFold DB（一个大规模预计算RNA结构库）。本章提供了使用这些资源的实用指南，使研究人员无需大量计算资源即可生成和解释RNA结构模型，从而促进RNA生物学中的结构和功能研究。
